Cross Romance - Koi to Mahjong to Hanafu.name: Cross Romance: Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to
Cross Romance - Koi to Mahjong to Hanafu.summary: Cross Romance: Koi to Mahjong to Hanafuda to is a great mix of adventure, love, and a mahjong game. The player controls a high school student that seems to be like a mahjong hero of his town and he will meet different girls during the game that will try to defeat him. The goal of the game is to win the six days tournament that takes places in the town.

WarCraft II - The Dark Saga.name: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga
WarCraft II - The Dark Saga.summary: Warcraft II: The Dark Saga is the console version of Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and its expansion built on. It is the same as the original product but with new features.
